related_questions.question: When is the best time to test for COVID at home?
related_questions.snippet: All COVID-19 tests can only give results that amount to a snapshot in time. That's why it makes sense to wait to take a test either until you have symptoms or until about five days after you've been exposed to someone who has tested positive for COVID-19. Taking a test immediately after exposure doesn't do much good.
